read.thesis: Supply discipline is returning in Europe: TRQ cut flat imports ~50% YoY and all EU blast furnaces restarted, with Q4 flat shipments guided up double digits; Ukraine idled, $1.1B charges.

utilisation.quote: all of our European blast furnaces are now running

capex.quote: the $4.5 billion-$5 billion remains a good reference for the CapEx envelope for the group going forward.

triggers.label: EU flat imports ~50% lower YoY
triggers.quote: imports of flat steel products were approximately 50% lower than a year ago

triggers.label: All EU blast furnaces restarted
triggers.quote: all of our European blast furnaces are now running

triggers.label: Q4 EU flat shipments up double digits YoY
triggers.quote: we expect shipments growth to accelerate in the fourth quarter and show a double-digit year-on-year improvement

triggers.label: Kryvyi Rih idled, $1.1B charges
triggers.quote: unable to safely and sustainably operate ArcelorMittal Kryvyi Rih (Ukraine) following multiple missile strikes

triggers.label: Energy costs being recovered
triggers.quote: Of course, we were hit by higher energy costs. We are in the process of recovering that.

guidance.quote: we expect shipments growth to accelerate in the fourth quarter and show a double-digit year-on-year improvement
the $4.5 billion-$5 billion remains a good reference for the CapEx envelope for the group going forward.
with the 2026 contribution now estimated at $0.5 billion
it should be about $50 million or so negative

prior_guidance_check.metric: EU flat volume growth in Q3 (per Q2 guide)
prior_guidance_check.quote: As we were guiding at the time of quarter two, we see higher shipments and flat despite the seasonality
revised to approximately 16 million tonnes for the full year, a reduction from the previous 18 million metric tonnes target
